1. This judgment -cum- award shall decide the petition under Section 166 and 140 of Motor Vehicle Act 1988 as amended up to date (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act')
filed by the petitioners for grant of compensation for the death of the deceased Saurabh Gulati in the road vehicular accident.

2. Brief facts of the case are that on 21.05.2016, the deceased alongwith his friend Irish Bhatia and cousin brother Deepak Kumar S/o Sh. Harish Gulati went to Jaipur for a tour and after outing, the deceased alongwith his friend Irish was returning back to Delhi in Car bearing no. It has been further stated that the deceased was driving his car bearing no. DL4CNE7272 and his friend Irish Bhatia was sitting on the co-driver seat.

It has been further stated that at about 5.30 am on 22.05.2016 when the deceased reached near M.G.Motors at Jaipur Delhi, the offending vehicle bearing no. It has been further stated that the deceased Saurabh Gulati was maintaining proper gap from the truck but the respondent no.1, all of a sudden applied break without any any indication and due to sudden break, the deceased himself applied break with force but could not control and his car collided with the offending vehicle with great force.

24.

The petitioners have examined the eye witness as PW4 and PW4 has reiterated and reaffirmed the stand that the accident in question was caused on account of the rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle by the respondent no.1.

The respondents no.1 and 2 have not led any evidence to prove that the accident in question was not taken place on account of the rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle by the respondent no.1.
